causal_screen.note: All retain the same 73 action coordinates. Experimental version IDs reject production checkpoint loading. Not official benchmark variants or proposed game changes.

scaling.methods: baseline and highest two-seed final validation mean among new methods; ties lower death rate, then name

protocol.test_selection: After all production runs finish: highest validation mean across production checkpoints; ties death rate, fewer steps, run name. Test once, never use ablations as candidates.

scaling_selection.criterion: highest two-seed final validation mean; ties lower deaths, then name
scaling_selection.note: No reserved test data used. Compare this alternative against baseline at matched budgets.

simulator-benchmarks.json.context: No training jobs active; active desktop; three repeats, same harness/seed protocol. Cross-version workload differences are not exact optimization speedups.

verification.json.mechanics: make check passed: 100 generated worlds, v4 geometry/support/contact/reach/tree/station/fall fixtures
verification.json.light: 24,000 arbitrary terrain/source edits match full propagation
verification.json.pixel: make check-pixel passed: 22/22 original tiles, 31/31 original inventory icons, player and three armor variants
verification.json.training_resources: Generated-world diagnostic controller and its traces are never used by learners.

resource-census.json.note: Necessary material conditions only; sufficient total material does not prove reachability within 3000 actions. Post-hoc design diagnostic, never learner input.

ui_fixture.note: Off-policy synthetic rendering fixture, visually checked; never training data or an agent performance result.

selection.criterion: highest validation mean; ties: lower death rate, fewer steps, run name
selection.note: Selection frozen before test. The reserved split is now consumed; do not tune against its results.
